content.title: How to watch Arkansas vs Hawai'i with Sling TV
content.text: BLOGSPORTSCOLLEGE BASKETBALLHOW TO WATCH ARKANSAS VS HAWAI'I WITH SLING TV#4 Arkansas vs. #13 Hawai'i Prediction, Odds, & How to Watch: March Madness® 2026#4 Arkansas and #13 Hawai'i go head-to-head at theModa Center for their West Region matchup. Here are details, our prediction, and how to watch with Sling TV.The No. 4 seed Arkansas Razorbacks enter March Madness® as one of the hottest teams in the country after capturing the SEC Tournament title. They face a No. 13 seed Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors squad that punched its ticket by winning the Big West tournament, marking the program's first appearance in the Big Dance since 2016. While Arkansas boasts elite offensive firepower, Hawai'i features a veteran eight-man rotation that specializes in defensive structure.To Watch the Razorbacks vs. Rainbow Warriors First Round game with Sling, use the link below for a 1 Day Pass subscription to TBS or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Game DetailInformationMatchup#4 Arkansas vs. #13 Hawai'iDate / TimeThursday, March 19, 2026 | 4:25 PM ETLocationModa Center, Portland, ORChannelTBSWatch With Sling1, 3, & 7 Day Pass or a monthly subscription to Sling Orange or Blue.Opening SpreadArkansas -15.5 (O/U 160.5)Arkansas Razorbacks Analysis Season Overview: Arkansas (26-8) finished second in the SEC regular season before a dominant run to the conference tournament title. Star Player: Darius Acuff Jr. (G). A National Player of the Year candidate, Acuff Jr. leads the team with 22.9 PPG and 6.4 APG, though he is currently nursing an ankle injury suffered in mid-February. The X-Factor: Offensive Firepower. The Razorbacks rank 3rd nationally in scoring (90.1 PPG) and 8th in offensive rating, making them nearly impossible to stop when their backcourt is in sync. Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors Analysis Season Overview: Hawai'i (24-8) retooled their roster to finish second in the Big West regular season and clinch the tournament championship. Star Player: Isaac Johnson (F). The leading scorer for the Rainbow Warriors averages 14.1 PPG and provides a physical presence inside. The Upset Formula: Defensive Structure. Hawai'i’s length and disciplined defensive rotations are designed to test high-scoring guards, potentially frustrating Arkansas' primary playmakers. Key Matchup & Advanced Analytics Position Battle: Backcourt athleticism vs. Defensive Discipline. Arkansas' freshman stars Meleek Thomas and Darius Acuff Jr. will face a Hawai'i defense that ranks 86th in points allowed (69.7 PPG). Statistical Edge: Arkansas holds a massive advantage in offensive efficiency (122.5) but ranks 233rd in defensive rating, providing Hawai'i an opening if the game becomes a shootout. Betting Trends: Arkansas is a heavy 15.5-point favorite, but the high total (160.5) suggests oddsmakers expect the Razorbacks to dictate a fast pace. Final Prediction & Betting Pick The Verdict: Arkansas wins to advance to the Round of 32. Final Score Prediction: Arkansas 88, Hawai'i 73. Best Bet: Arkansas -15.5.
